items.description: The Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum House is a historic building and former residential quarters of the former ruler of Dubai, Saeed bin Maktoum Al Maktoum.
facts: Located in the Al Shindagha area.
It is now a museum that contains artifacts and images of old Dubai.

items.description: Al Ain Palace Museum, also known as Qasr al-Ain, was the former home of the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the founding father of the UAE.
facts: It was converted into a museum in 1998.
Showcases the daily life in a ruler's fort.

items.description: The Al Hajar Mountains are one of the highest mountain ranges in eastern Arabia, separating the low coastal plain of Oman from the high desert plateau.
facts: The highest peak is Jebel Shams.
The mountains are rich in flora and fauna.
